title: Memory - Evolutionary Drivers
content_html:
Memory - Evolutionary Drivers

Evolution shaped memory for adaptation — trading off accuracy for efficiency, prediction, and social transmission. These five drivers sit around a central goal: usable memory for action.

Adaptive Memory

Efficient • Predictive • Shareable

Compression

Chunking & gist reduce load and energy cost. Stores patterns, not pixels—minimizes metabolic and WM load.

Prediction

Event boundaries encode change to forecast what happens next. Segmenting continuous input into events supports forecasting.

Abstraction

Schemas generalize across contexts; learn once, reuse. Semanticization and schemas enable transfer and rapid inference.

Reconstruction

Reassemble past to meet present goals; efficient but biased. Gist + schema fill in gaps; supports creativity and planning.

Narrative

Package events for teaching, planning, and culture. Event structure is communicable; boosts cooperation and culture.
